status: Source-development registration before any new visual-maze learner fit; not target GO.
purpose: Correct useful learning/source-only recipe selection before biological rule fitting, brain-derived controls and cross-species transfer/retention. Simulation-only calibration is not learned species transfer.
author_scope: Embodied sensory actions, outcome learning, OOD, continual plasticity, retained skills and spiking cost; real observations separate from digital reconstruction.
native_data_use: Published geometry only. No animal trajectory or neuron outcomes fitted at this stage.
known_prior_data: Native data/older results were already analyzed; no claim of untouched confirmatory data. No new visual-maze learner fits at registration.

source.curriculum_information: Goal-based spawn bands are simulator-side source curricula, never policy inputs; sampling rules and total interaction allowance shared.
source.boundary_rule: Curriculum/final run boundaries force episode terminal in every method; PPO marks8slots terminal at matching total-frame boundary. Last reward credited once, no phantom action.

select_protocol.frozen_arm: Fresh checkpoint clone, no weight updates, state reset per trial.
select_protocol.adaptation_arm: Fresh checkpoint clone per repeat, configs6then7,10native starts each, weights kept across trials/layouts, state reset per trial; no layout/boundary ID.
select_protocol.primary_selection: Mean adaptive success over both layouts/all10trials/3repeats, averaged over all3seeds for a rate.
select_protocol.tie_break: Higher frozen mean success, then lower registered candidate index; no seed-specific choices.
select_protocol.feedback_accounting: Selection is source development, reported separately; each arm60trials/2700decision maximum, count actual interactions and rejected candidates.

source.selection_rule: Complete all7methods x3rates x3seeds including failures, independent audit before selection; no partial-result tuning.
source.subsequent_stage: Fresh longer selected source runs and biological-rule fitting require separate bound settings; no target fit GO from this protocol.

features.texture_sampling: Uniform per episode, environment RNG independent of layout/goal/policy RNG/phase; not deterministic layout ID.
features.policy_information: Pixels, contact, last reward and own last action only; no pose/goal/map/geodesic/layout/phase inputs.
features.clock: One neural update per digital decision; tau values are decision-step constants, not physiological milliseconds.

actions.camera: Faces attempted move; initial heading toward centre is declared assumption.

bptt.loss: Episode Monte Carlo actorcritic, detached actor advantage, independent entropy; SGD/Adam distinct.
bptt.spiking_graph: Same forward/filter/initialization as eprop; recurrent spike input differentiable, reset detached.

eprop.form: Reward online Methods form/plainSGD; not released Atari Adam/nstep or benchmark reproduction.

resource_policy.device: CPU; CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES empty. GPU1only later; noGUI/Unity/GPU0.
resource_policy.energy: Events/bytes are proxies, not measured joules.

technical_GO_requirements: Exact32768frames and boundary/reward accounting source-shaped dryrun
Finite states/checkpoint replay and code/data hashes bound
failure_policy: Retain failed/nonfinite fits; no silent retry/clip/reset. Technical repair gets new version before affected fits.
scientific_next_gate: Useful control beyond matched random reference and absolute source competence/uncertainty before longer/biological/target protocol; no universal conclusion from one failure.
